method_signature: public TransactionData execute(PlatformContext context, TransactionData data)

request_data_extractions.purpose: Extract the master component code used to anchor the multi-table configuration stream joins.
Extract the internal record tracking tracking token to append to the response payload.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> joinParams = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); joinParams.put("child_part", short_part_number); context.streamJoinData("cu_esn_bom_option_config_notes", "cu_wc_option_child", "option_assembly_num", "rev_option_no", joinParams, record -> { distinctConfigs.add(String.valueOf(record.get("design_config_num"))); });
workflow_steps.purpose: Stream distinct design blueprint tokens via a dynamic cross-entity join matching component option revision definitions.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: for(String cfg : distinctConfigs) { int totalVolume = context.executeCountQuery("cu_esn_bom_option_config_notes", "countSerialsByConfig", cfg); volumeMap.put(cfg, totalVolume); } List<Map.Entry<String, Integer>> topThree = volumeMap.entrySet().stream().sorted(Map.Entry.<String, Integer>comparingByValue().reversed()).limit(3).collect(Collectors.toList());
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute cumulative manufacturing asset counts per design key to identify the top three high-volume configurations.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: int currentYear = java.util.Calendar.getInstance().get(java.util.Calendar.YEAR); int tenYearCount = context.executeVolumeQuery("cu_esn_bom_option_config_notes", "byYearCutoff", topThree.get(0).getKey(), currentYear - 10); if (tenYearCount == 0) { context.triggerExternalService("WindchillService", data); return data; }
workflow_steps.purpose: Validate historical production viability within a trailing 10-year block, routing to external syncing tools upon null asset recognition.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: int recentCount = context.executeHorizonQuery("cu_esn_bom_option_config_notes", "recentHorizon", topThree.get(0).getKey(), currentYear - 5); int olderCount = context.executeHorizonQuery("cu_esn_bom_option_config_notes", "olderHorizon", topThree.get(0).getKey(), currentYear - 10, currentYear - 5); if (recentCount > olderCount) { finalConfig[0] = topThree.get(0).getKey(); } else { context.triggerExternalService("Criteria2Service", topThree); return data; }
workflow_steps.purpose: Perform volume delta checks between a five-year and a ten-year manufacturing window to determine active configuration status routing.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> cfgParams = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); cfgParams.put("code", finalConfig[0]); context.streamDataFromDB("configuration", "bySelectedConfigCode", cfgParams, record -> { resolvedSpecs.putAll(record); });
workflow_steps.purpose: Resolve six master catalog design dimensions using the dynamically verified primary config code token.

conditional_routing.condition: recent production volume metrics strictly outpace the historical baseline window limits

scenarios.description: Verifies successful part master updates when recent configuration volumes exceed older baseline periods.
Verifies that an external manufacturing integration trigger is thrown when no active serials exist across a 10-year horizon.
Verifies that the system routes processing to a Criteria 2 handler when historical configuration volumes beat recent activity metrics.
